notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Achievement Fix[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused "Die x Times Achievements" not being registered
[*] Fixed a bug that didn't bring out developer comments upon death. 
[*] Added One extra achievement on passing the lava stage
[*] Enabled Video settings
[*] Removed Controls Settings entirely(Engine limitation)
[*] Added new bugs to be fixed later
[/list]


Note : Due to engine limitations we are unable to give players to customize keybindings for now.
